title: Van Der Valk Custom Jangada Impresses During Sea Trials
description: Van Der Valk's custom Jangada superyacht completes successful sea trials showcasing advanced design and performance.
html:
Innovative Design and Performance Highlight New Superyacht

Van Der Valk’s latest custom superyacht, Jangada, has recently completed its sea trials, marking a significant milestone in the vessel’s development. The trials, conducted in Dutch waters, demonstrated the yacht’s impressive handling, stability, and overall performance, confirming the shipyard’s commitment to quality and innovation in the luxury maritime sector.

The 47-meter yacht features a sleek design that balances elegance with functionality, incorporating a steel hull and aluminum superstructure to optimize weight distribution and durability. The exterior styling reflects a modern aesthetic with clean lines and expansive glass surfaces, allowing natural light to flood the interior spaces.

Powered by twin diesel engines, Jangada delivers a smooth and efficient cruising experience, with a top speed exceeding 15 knots and a comfortable range suitable for extended voyages. The propulsion system is complemented by advanced stabilization technology, ensuring comfort even in challenging sea conditions.

Inside, the yacht offers luxurious accommodations for up to 12 guests, with bespoke interiors crafted from high-quality materials. The layout includes spacious social areas, a well-equipped galley, and multiple outdoor decks designed for relaxation and entertainment. The design team worked closely with the owner to tailor every detail, resulting in a vessel that reflects personal taste and lifestyle.

The successful completion of the sea trials positions Jangada as a standout entry in the competitive superyacht market, particularly within the South Florida and international brokerage scenes where demand for custom, high-performance yachts continues to grow. Van Der Valk’s reputation for craftsmanship and client collaboration is further solidified through this project, signaling promising prospects for future builds.

As the yacht prepares for delivery, industry observers anticipate strong interest from discerning buyers seeking a blend of innovation, comfort, and style. Jangada exemplifies the evolving trends in yacht design, where technological advancement meets bespoke luxury, setting new benchmarks in the maritime luxury sector.
